entities.name: Francis T. Nicholls
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Redding Tillou Nicholls was an American attorney, politician, and soldier who served as a Brigadier General in the Confederate States Army, the 28th Governor of Louisiana, and as Chief Justice of the Louisiana Supreme Court.
